verses.gurmukhi: ਤ੍ਰਿਗੁਨ ਅਤੀਤ ਚਤੁਰਥ ਗੁਨ ਗੰਮਿਤਾ ਕੈ ਪੰਚ ਤਤ ਉਲੰਘਿ ਪਰਮ ਤਤ ਵਾਸੀ ਹੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: tiragun ateet chaturath gun ga(n)mitaa kai pa(n)ch tat ula(n)gh param tat vaasee hai ||

en.bdb: detaching himself from the worldly attractions and the three its of maya, a Guru-conscious person acquires fourth state and discarding all adorations of the body lives in the memory the Lord.

verses.gurmukhi: ਖਟ ਰਸ ਤਿਆਗਿ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਰਸ ਕਉ ਪ੍ਰਾਪਤਿ ਭਏ ਪੂਰਿ ਸਰ ਸਪਤ ਅਨਹਦ ਅਭਿਆਸੀ ਹੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: khaT ras tiaag prem ras kau praapat bhe poor sar sapat anahadh abhiaasee hai ||

en.bdb: He is not enamoured by the tastes of worldly things, and enjoys the bliss of love of the Lord; and celestial music by keeping Him in his mind all the time

verses.gurmukhi: ਅਸਟ ਸਿਧਾਂਤ ਭੇਦਿ ਨਾਥਨ ਕੈ ਨਾਥ ਭਏ ਦਸਮ ਸਥਲ ਸੁਖ ਸਾਗਰ ਬਿਲਾਸੀ ਹੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: asaT sidhaa(n)t bhedh naathan kai naath bhe dhasam sathal sukh saagar bilaasee hai ||

en.bdb: he renunciates yog and ways of Naths and surpasses them ;all-spiritually, and reaching the ultimate, enjoys all happiness and peace.

verses.gurmukhi: ਉਨਮਨ ਮਗਨ ਗਗਨ ਹੁਇ ਨਿਝਰ ਝਰੈ ਸਹਜ ਸਮਾਧਿ ਗੁਰ ਪਰਚੈ ਉਦਾਸੀ ਹੈ ॥੩੧॥
verses.translit_en: aunaman magan gagan hui nijhar jharai sahaj samaadh gur parachai udhaasee hai ||31||

en.bdb: because of his high spiritual state and residing his conscious awareness in the Dasam Duar, he gets detached from worldly things and remains in a state of bliss. (31)
